div.head: VI Atr Lat 4
div.ab: K. Canonici namque in suis se monasteriis ita obseruent, ut in continentia pura et in castitate magna Domino regulariter deseruiant, horis competentibus officium diuinum in ęcclesiis pariter concelebrent et, si eo loci substantię habundantia uictualis ne defuęrit, in suis per dies singulos prandeant refectoriis, noctibus quoque singulis, ut eis regulę monstrat auctoritas, in dormitoriis requiescant. Quodsi hęc obseruare neglexerint, uel regulariter emendent uel de monasteriis eiciantur et Dei hereditate careant.
div.note: Latin paraphrase of VI Atr (early 11th c.; K = Cotton Claudius A III f. 30, perhaps by Archbishop Wulfstan), text in column K (Liebermann’s text; until October 2026 in column T). Liebermann gives no German translation for it: for the meaning see the matching Old English chapter of VI Atr above, which it paraphrases (Liebermann prints in small type the words that correspond exactly to the Old English).; T: corrected against Gesetze I, October 2026 (was “(Liebermann’s Latin Paraphrase)”, now “∅ (moved to K)”)
